meta.note: v2 'Signal' palette. Family hues validated with the dataviz palette validator (all checks pass, dark surface #0d1117 and light surfaces #ffffff/#f3f5f8). Lineage from the v1 console in README.md.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool graphite in dark, cold paper in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and sections on ground; the surface every family hue was validated against.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Drawer, tooltips, hovered cards.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed tracks: score bars, ring lanes, inputs, alternate 10-second bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and grid. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and ticks. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels on any surface (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Brand and live signal: primary button fill, playhead, active stage bead, scroll bow, API online. Text on it is on-volt. In light theme it is a fill only, never text or a thin line.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt fill (15:1).

tokens.name: volt-ink
tokens.usage: Volt as text or a thin mark (sam tick, live readouts). 4.3:1 or more in light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Failure state only (FAILED, 401, API not connected), always beside a word. Not used by any family.

tokens.name: fam-western
tokens.usage: Family slot 1: General/Western (piano, drums, flute, acoustic and bass guitar, strings section).

tokens.name: fam-indian-strings
tokens.usage: Family slot 2: Indian strings (sitar, sarod, sarangi, veena, santoor, mandolin, tanpura).

tokens.name: fam-indian-wind
tokens.usage: Family slot 3: Indian wind and keys (harmonium, bansuri, shehnai).

tokens.name: fam-indian-percussion
tokens.usage: Family slot 4: Indian percussion (tabla, dholak, mridangam, ghatam, duff/khanjari).

tokens.name: fam-electronic
tokens.usage: Family slot 5: Electronic (electric guitar, kick, synth, 808, electric piano, drum machine).

tokens.name: fam-brass
tokens.usage: Family slot 6: Brass and woodwind (trumpet, saxophone, trombone).

tokens.name: fam-modern-strings
tokens.usage: Family slot 7: Modern strings (violin, cello). Marks only; names stay in ink.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page. One word may switch to the accent italic.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Instrument names in result rows, panel titles.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: Italic, one word per headline, sized to match the headline around it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload a song and the service returns the instruments that stand out most strongly.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers, chips, status. Decode on reveal.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding block, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding inline, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, column gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between groups; the background grid pitch (v1 used 46px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Window ticks, timeline hits, the string fret.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the dropzone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, stage beads, the family dot.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Drawer and floating readouts.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons, dragged-over dropzone.

tokens.name: glow-volt
tokens.usage: Live elements only: the playhead, the active bead, a button while its request runs.
